sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slowly.
Part two, Greece in simple words.
There is a lot of history.
There is a lot of sea.
Naphtlio is in the south of Greece.

Part five, streets and old houses.

You can see the whole city.
Part seven, daily life in Naphtlio.
Part eight, food in Greek taste.
Part nine, the sea in the port.
Part 12, the soul of Naphtlio and goodbye.
